subject: literacy
concept: Understanding how common prefixes (un-, re-, pre-) change a word's meaning
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading morphology sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student attaches a prefix tile to a base-word tile and states the new meaning
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a prefixed word to the picture showing its new meaning
exercise.abstract: Student defines a prefixed word by identifying the prefix's meaning

misconception_flags: ignores the prefix's effect on meaning, defining the word as if the prefix weren't there

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
